# T001: Session store and types

## Goal
When this task is done, `src/auth/store.ts` implements the `SessionStore` contract with an in-memory map and `src/auth/types.ts` exports the `Session`, `SessionStore` and `TokenCodec` types exactly as written in the spec.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a store and `now = 0`, When `create("u1", 0)` is called with `sessionMinutes: 30`, Then the session has a 32-character hex id and `expiresAt` of 1,800,000.
- Given a session that expires at 1,800,000, When `get(id, 1_800_000)` is called, Then it returns `null`.
- Given a session that expires at 1,800,000, When `get(id, 1_799_999)` is called, Then the session is returned unchanged.

## Target files
- src/auth/store.ts
- src/auth/types.ts
- test/auth/store.test.ts

## Contracts
- SessionStore (spec.md §Contracts)

## Out of scope
- Refresh logic in `touch` (T003).
- Any HTTP route (T002, T004).

## Notes for the worker
Keep the store free of clock reads; the caller passes `now`.
